decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety range sits close to the core offer and serves steady demand in a growing industry, so without evidence of a shortfall against aspirations the firm has no trigger for problemistic search and keeps it.
ESD occupational shoes meet a persistent regulatory and industrial need and fit the firm's specialization, so with no evidence of poor performance it remains an established part of the range.

A safety shoe series is core business, but series in this market are refreshed on a cycle and may be replaced by newer collections, so the risk of withdrawal is somewhat higher, though keeping it remains the default absent a performance shortfall.
